Re-scored 4 Nov: Truth: the tile order breaks 'one rule, one place'. Spec 04 already has the rule for exactly this state (§4 'Aisles near a search that found nothing', lead ruling 30 Oct, TD14): the closest item's aisle, then the aisles most often bought together with it in the shop's orders, then the shop's aisles — built as today/FindItems.tsx nearAisles. The counter's OpenAisle is a second, different copy (closest aisle, then the shop's aisles), and the new §4.3 row restates that different order. From the demo books at 17 Oct 10:41 the existing rule gives Adhesives · Roofing · Fasteners for 'tile cutter' (KC21, KC25) and Plumbing · Fasteners · Tools for 'PPR pipe 25mm' (KC26, KC28); the boards draw Adhesives · Roofing · Cement and Plumbing · Roofing · Cement. Fix: move nearAisles (and shopAisles, which the counter imports from today/data.ts, another tab's internals) into src/core; call it from Today and the Counter; in §4.3 keep only 'every Nothing-called state shows three aisle tiles below the ask card, page content that may run under the dock' and point to the existing row for the order; redraw the tiles on KC21, KC25, KC26 and KC28 to the rule's result. If Kevin or the lead prefers the counter's simpler order, change the TD14 row and Today instead: one rule either way, never two.

Tiles under the dock: acceptable, keep them. They are scrolled content in the page, as the shelf rows run under the dock on KC03/KC05. What matters on this state (the sent ask) is wholly above the dock, and every tile shows its icon, name and count with 83 px of tap target above the dock's edge (y 577-660); the cut edge reads as 'more below'. Dropping them would leave the walk-in with no next step on a state that ends in an ask.
Build: the page must scroll far enough that the tiles clear the dock (bottom padding at least the dock's height, as .kc-body has), and add the aisle tiles (also KC26's open fix).
